title: Uchū Nanchara Kotetsu-kun Film Unveils Trailer, Theme Song Artist
content: Kadokawa revealed on Monday the trailer and theme song artist for the Uchū Nanchara Kotetsu-kun: Ukkari Detekita Uchūjin o Sagase! ( Space Academy : Find the Aliens Who Accidentally Came Out!) film based on Yūji Nishimura 's web manga Uchū Nanchara Kotetsu-kun ( Space Academy ).
author: ANN

title: 5 Reasons Why Naruto Is Secretly the Best Anime of the Shonen Big Three
content: Even though several years have passed and a new age of the anime and manga industry has begun, the legacy of the Shonen Big Three remains unmatched. Each of these series has unique premises and power systems, which helped set the standards for the new generation of manga.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Kino no Tabi' Creator Launches New Manga
content: Light novel author Keiichi Sigsawa began serializing his first original manga with manga author Hayato Asaki titled Kemono-tachi no Peregrinatio ( Peregrinatio Bestiarum ) on the Weekly CoroCoro Comic website on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 5 Iconic Demon Slayer Quotes That Define the Series
content: Koyoharu Gotouge’s Demon Slayer is one of the most popular anime and manga series, known for its stellar animation, emotional storytelling, and captivating characters. The story is set in early 1900s Japan, a time when the country is plagued by demons who attack humans in the dead of the night.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest New Anime Shares The Final Main Look
content: The exciting Summer 2026 anime season is finally here, and the one unexpected anime that’s making waves on social media is Crunchyroll’s Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia . The anime is produced by Science SARU, the same animation studio behind the acclaimed Shonen Jump+ hit Dandadan .
author: ComicBook

title: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Preview Confirms a Character Fans Wanted Dead Should Have Died
content: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex has released another preview for its upcoming installment, Chapter 36, and this new preview adds even more emotional turmoil by showing that it would have been better for the protagonist if one character everyone wanted gone had died.
author: ComicBook

title: Naruto Live-Action Movie Update Reveals It Will Start Filming Sooner Than You Think
content: Naruto is now in the works on a major live-action feature film debut from the same director behind Spider-Man: Brand New Day , and an update for its global casting search has revealed that filming with start on the new feature much sooner than fans would think.

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Hypes Streaming Launch With New Posters One Year Later
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle is finally on the verge of its highly anticipated streaming release one long year after the film first hit theaters across Japan , and the film is going all out for the occasion with some special posters highlighting its biggest moments.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Creator Shares Surprising Yuji Crossover With Iconic Musician
content: Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s creator has returned with an unexpected crossover for Yuji Itadori with some new art shared with an iconic musician. title: Nearly 15 Years Later, Hunter x Hunter Finally Brings Back Its Biggest Stars
content: Hunter x Hunter is back in action this Summer with new chapters after a two year long hiatus , and the newest chapter of the series has finally brought back Gon and Killua nearly 15 years since they were last seen together.
